'''Ikumi Hayama''' (Japanese: '''葉山いくみ''' ''Hayama Ikumi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is also credited as '''Ikumi Fujiwara''' (Japanese: '''郁美藤原''' ''Fujiwara Ikumi'').

==Biography==
Hayama was born on November 17, 1984, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She became a voice actress as an adult, and also provided her voice for narrations. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, voicing [[Burgundy]], {{an|Cilan}}'s main [[rival]]. Hayama was once affiliated with the talent agency Vi-Vo, but is currently affiliated with Clare Voice.
